t: Crime Scene Solvers: Deadly Trap in the Forest - Christophe Belle
st: Deadly Trap in the Forest - Christophe Belle
d: On March 19th 1998, Akira Ojima, a 57 years old japanese architect, is found dead in the fridge of a villa in Nanterre.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: The Priscillia Ciatti Case
d: The corpse of Priscillia Ciatti, 14, is discovered by the side of a field, a few hundred metres from her family home. The teenager has been stabbed sixty times with a knife and –an extra sordid detail – a devil mask is found next to her body.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: Murdered For a Fake Treasure - Troadec Case
st: Murdered For a Fake Treasure - Troadec Case
d: On March 28th 2013, the burnt body of Anne Barbot, 38 years old, is discovered in a forest of Maine-et-Loire.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: (Ruth Légeret Case) Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake
st: (Ruth Légeret Case) Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake
d: On January 4, 2006, Ruth Légeret was found dead in the middle of a pool of blood at her luxurious property in Vevey, Switzerland. Next to her was the lifeless body of her friend, Marina Studer. Who could have killed these two simple and wealthy widows?

t: Crime Scene Solvers: The Willy Pomonti Case
d: Willy Pomonti, a retired architect, is found savagely murdered in his opulent villa in La Celle-Saint-Cloud, near Paris. It soon becomes clear that the man has been tortured prior to death.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case)
st: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case)
d: On June 18, 2011, Marie-Jeanne Meyer, 17-years old, waved goodbye to her sister before leaving for her daily jog on the heights of Tournon in Ardèche. Three days later, her mutilated body was found in a freshly dug pit, near an area known to be cursed.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: The Adeline Piet Case
d: A man walks into a gendarmerie near Saint-Malo to report that his wife has been missing since the previous day. The couple are going through a divorce, but this mother would never have left her seven children alone! What has happened to Adeline Piet?

t: Crime Scene Solvers: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)
st: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)
d: On March 31, 2003, firefighters were called to a fire in a housing estate of Meyrargues, near Aix-en-Provence. On site, they discovered a horrific scene: the tortured and charred bodies of a mother and her daughter, Chantal and Audrey D'Amato.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: A Dire Deception (Laurence Maille Case)
d: On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: Stabed In Her Bed: The Maureen Jaquier Case
st: Stabed In Her Bed: The Maureen Jaquier Case
d: On February 27, 2015, in Toulouse, the parents of 19-year-old Maureen Jacquier discover their daughter stabbed several times in her bed.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: Shot At Point-Blank: The Aurelie Barbot Affair
st: Shot At Point-Blank: The Aurelie Barbot Affair
d: On December 20, 2012, in Val d'Izé (Ille-et-Vilaine), Aurélie Barbot, 29, was killed on her doorstep with a bullet to the head.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Honeymoon Killers (Van Beers Case)
st: Crime Scene Solvers: Honeymoon Killers (Van Beers Case)
d: Marc Van Beers, a 36-year old Brussels tax lawyer, dies in a road accident while on honeymoon. His wife Aurore is unharmed by the accident.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Mysterious Hanging On Houseboat (Aubry case)
st: Crime Scene Solvers: Mysterious Hanging On Houseboat (Aubry case)
d: Dominique Aubry, a rich widow of 58, is found hanged on her barge in Neuilly. It appears that since the death of her husband on a trip to Mauritius, Dominique Aubry has been ailing.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: Only DNA Can Say - Angélique Dumetz
st: Only DNA Can Say - Angélique Dumetz
d: On February 23th 2017, policemen are alerted of the disapearrance of Brigitte Troadec, her husband Pascal, and their children Sébastien and Charlotte.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: The Jean-Raymond Blatti Case
d: Arriving at her work, the secretary of a small firm in the suburbs of Geneva finds the body of Jean-Raymond Blatti, the company's new accountant. The man is lying in a pool of blood and, on his belly, the murderer has written \"DIRTY RAPIST\".

t: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: A Very Strange Suicide (Muller case)
st: Crime Scene Solvers: A Very Strange Suicide (Muller case)
d: Police in Strasbourg receive a startling emergency call from Doctor Jean-Louis Muller, a forensic pathologist well known in the region.
